entries.text: What's this?
entries.speaker: General Wegman

entries.text: That, we believe, is ground zero. Once we analyze the flight data recorder, we hope to confirm it's where the warp began.
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: Warp?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Beam me up, scotty.
entries.speaker: Jeff

entries.text: It's a tear in the space-time continuum. An anomaly created by the malfunction of the aircraft... Which was operating in gravity pulse mode before it went down.
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: We've been flying these things since '53. I never heard of anything like this.
entries.speaker: General Wegman

entries.text: According to quantum physics, it's possible.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Antigravity systems utilize bends in space and time for propulsion. A sudden shift in a craft's trajectory... Could create the kind of distortion we're witnessing right here-- a lizard and a rock existing in the same time and space.
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: If this is where your so-called warp began, we would have all seen it. The three of us were out on highway 375 at the time, sir, intercepting two FBI agents.
entries.speaker: Jeff

entries.text: The fact that none of us remembers seeing it is evidence that my theory is correct.
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: And how's that?
entries.speaker: Jeff

entries.text: Lost time.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Lost time is a common symptom of close proximity to antigravity propulsion.
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: Then how come my head isn't in a rock, or Morris's?
entries.speaker: Jeff

entries.text: That's one question I haven't been able to answer. It is possible we suffered consequences from our exposure that we're not fully aware of.
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: What do we do about it?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: That's your department-- keep it out of the paper, make sure witnesses disappear.
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: Yeah, but how do we reverse it? How do we get the lizard out of the rock?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Who says we can?
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: This is not a marriage. It's a farce!
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: What?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: You're not attracted to me anymore. I disgust you, don't I?
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: No. No, it's-it's not that you're disgusting. [ stammering ] it's just that--
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: It's just that you don't want to make love to me ever again, that's all. That, and you mumbled something about Scully in your sleep. Who is Scully, Morris? Is it another woman?
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: Does Scully sound like a woman's name to you?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Who is Scully? Tell me.
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: Look, Joanne, I'm sure I've told you many times in the past... That there are things about my work that unfortunately I have to keep a secret.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Oh, no, buster. That's not gonna fly this time.
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: My point is that there are a lot of things you don't know about me. And... I've just been-- I've been under a lot of pressure lately. Up is down. Black is white. I don't know where I stand anymore. I don't even know who I am, really, anymore. I just-- I know for sure... That I am not the man you married. I'm just not, and I'm sorry. I'm truly sorry.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Oh, god, Morris. I didn't know. They have that pill now. We can work this out. There's other ways to be intimate.
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: [ doorbell rings ] I think that was the doorbell.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: We can make this work. Yes?
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: Hi. My name is Dana Scully. I'm looking for Morris Fletcher.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Morris! You son of a bitch!
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: I'm sorry. Uh, Morris Fletcher?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Scully, it's me. It's Mulder.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: You're, uh-- you're the man from the other night from area 51?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Liar!
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: You phoned me. Mind telling me what this is about?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: No, I'm Mulder. I'm really Mulder. I switched bodies, places, identities with this man, Morris Fletcher-- the man that you think is Mulder, but he's not. Of course you don't believe me. Why was I expecting anything different? Your full name is Dana katherine Scully. Your badge number is-- hell, I don't know your badge number. Your mother is margaret. Your brother is bill, jr. He's in the navy and hates me. Lately for lunch, you've been having this little six-ounce cup of plain yogurt, into which you stir bee pollen because you're on a bee pollen kick... Even though I tell you you're a scientist and should know better.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Cheater!
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: Look, any of that information could've been gathered by anyone.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Even that yogurt thing? That is so you. That is so Scully. It's good to know you haven't changed. That's somewhat comforting.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Look, I don't know what the point of all this is.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I'll prove it to you.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: No, you won't. But I wouldn't mind if you came clean with me.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Scientific proof about what happened to us on that road two nights ago. Fair enough?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: I am calling the police.
entries.speaker: Joanne Fletcher

entries.text: Good-bye, mr. Fletcher.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: I will prove it to you, Scully. Tonight. I'll prove everything. Okay?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: [ car engine starts ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Howard grodin.
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: Mr. Grodin? This is special agent Mulder of the federal bureau of investigatation. How are you this morning?
entries.speaker: Morris Fletcher (in Mulder’s body)

entries.text: How did you get this number?
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: Frankly, that's what I wanted to talk to you about. Sir, I am obligated to tell you that you have a security leak in your facility. A man with whom you have worked very closely has contacted this office on several occasions... And offered me access to highly classified information.
entries.speaker: Morris Fletcher (in Mulder’s body)

entries.text: Would you happen to have a name for this man?
entries.speaker: Howard

entries.text: Why, yes. Yes, I would.
entries.speaker: Morris Fletcher (in Mulder’s body)

entries.text: [ cell phone ringing ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: Scully.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You're in Nevada again.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Uh, sir, I--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Do not speak, agent. Listen. Your partner already apprised me of his conversation with the air force... And his fervent desire to save you from making a fatal career mistake. Therefore, you will follow my instructions to the letter.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Sir, I don't know what Mulder told you--
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: You will follow my instructions to the letter. Otherwise don't bother coming back from Nevada.
entries.speaker: Alvin Kersh

entries.text: Can I help you?
entries.speaker: Attendant

entries.text: Scully, I got it. I got the proof.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: [ vehicles approaching ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: [ rifles cocking ]
entries.speaker: Sound

entries.text: I'm sorry.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully

entries.text: Scully, you?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)

entries.text: Damn it, Morris.
entries.speaker: Jeff

entries.text: You! You son of a bitch! You orchestrated this whole thing! He's not me, Scully! Would I do this? Would I do this? Scully! No, you bastard! Tell her the truth! Scully, he's not me! He's not me! Scully, he's not me!
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder (in Morris Fletcher’s body)
